description: Stormwater Facilities - Creek and Ditch Systems is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. This polygon featureclass was created as a supplemental inventory database for Pierce County owned and/or maintained stormwater facilities and/or maintained creek and ditch systems that are generally located outside of Pierce County public right-of-way and accept stormwater runoff from public infrastructure. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The table has 15 columns. The portal shows 2024-06-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
